description: MTA Yerbilimleri map viewer (earth science data, Türkiye) is a hazard data portal run by General Directorate of Mineral Research and Exploration (MTA), Türkiye. An earth-science map viewer for regional-scale geological survey work. The page names earthquake data taken from the national seismological monitoring network through cooperation between MTA and AFAD; vector data from MTA's digital database are available for a fee on request. Coverage: Türkiye. Part of the data is free of charge and part is paid or licensed on request. The licence is: all rights reserved by MTA and AFAD; written permission is needed to reproduce or distribute. Caveats: only the earthquake layer is described on the page (other layers such as faults or landslides are not); the viewer is for orientation and the data come without liability. It can support seismic context for infrastructure siting studies in Türkiye. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
